description: Disproved legacy physical bank retained as a migration tombstone. The former encounter-zone rows duplicate the complete map descriptor table and do not identify a separate writable ROM extent.
verification_method: All 47 former rows are byte-for-byte the canonical 32-byte map descriptors at 0x53D910. Code at 0x0806921C..0x0806922A indexes that base with a 32-byte stride and consumes byte +0x1D; runtime evidence independently binds map row 41 to 0x53DE30. This disproves a separate physical encounter bank, not every possible logical interpretation of map fields.
notes: Legacy encounter-zone editor rows are diagnostic-only and must not write ROM bytes. Any future random-encounter model requires an independent ROM identity and consumer chain.
